Document 284
Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969–1976, Volume XI,
                    South Asia Crisis, 1971
284. Message From the
Soviet Leadership
to
                        President
Nixon
1
Moscow
,
December 12, 1971
.
The first contacts with the Government of India and personally with Prime
                        Minister I.
Gandhi
on the question
                        which was raised by President
Nixon
in his letter
2
testify to the fact that
                        the Government of India has no intention to take any military actions
                        against West Pakistan.
The Soviet leaders believe that this makes the situation easier and hope that
                        the Government of Pakistan will draw from this appropriate conclusions.
As far as other questions raised in the Presidentʼs letter are concerned the
                        answers will be given in the shortest of time.
